# Anbennar Overhaul: generated by tools/build_rie_dwarves.py from Realms in Exile and Anbennar.
# Anbennar Overhaul: do not edit by hand; rerun the generator after an RiE, Anbennar or CK3 update.

# Province scope: a dwarven hold.
aov_rie_hold_province_trigger = {
	has_holding_type = dwarven_hold_holding
}

# Province scope: mountain terrains (RiE's mountain building requirement).
aov_rie_mountain_terrain_trigger = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = aov_rie_mountain_terrain_tt
		OR = {
			terrain = mountains
			terrain = desert_mountains
			terrain = dwarven_hold
			terrain = dwarven_hold_surface
			terrain = cavern
			terrain = dwarven_road
		}
	}
}

# Province scope: mountain or hill terrains (RiE's hill building requirement).
aov_rie_hill_terrain_trigger = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = aov_rie_hill_terrain_tt
		OR = {
			terrain = mountains
			terrain = desert_mountains
			terrain = dwarven_hold
			terrain = dwarven_hold_surface
			terrain = cavern
			terrain = dwarven_road
			terrain = hills
		}
	}
}

# Province scope: the holder is a dwarf.
aov_rie_dwarven_holder_trigger = {
	scope:holder = { is_dwarvish_culture = yes }
}

# Province scope: a dwarf holding something other than a dwarven hold.
aov_rie_surface_dwarf_trigger = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = aov_rie_surface_dwarf_tt
		aov_rie_dwarven_holder_trigger = yes
		NOT = { has_holding_type = dwarven_hold_holding }
	}
}

# Province scope: the province has one of the 15 ore deposits.
aov_rie_has_deposit_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_province_modifier = mining_mithril_province_modifier
		has_province_modifier = mining_gold_province_modifier
		has_province_modifier = mining_silver_province_modifier
		has_province_modifier = mining_iron_province_modifier
		has_province_modifier = mining_copper_province_modifier
		has_province_modifier = mining_tin_province_modifier
		has_province_modifier = mining_lead_province_modifier
		has_province_modifier = mining_diamond_province_modifier
		has_province_modifier = mining_ruby_province_modifier
		has_province_modifier = mining_sapphire_province_modifier
		has_province_modifier = mining_emerald_province_modifier
		has_province_modifier = mining_amethyst_province_modifier
		has_province_modifier = mining_onyx_province_modifier
		has_province_modifier = mining_peridot_province_modifier
		has_province_modifier = mining_quartz_province_modifier
	}
}
